rocco.config.restart: Applies when you rejoin the world.
rocco.config.tip.impression_voices: Name=Fish Audio voice ID, separated by semicolons (Vegeta=abc123; Goku=def456). The mod ships no real people's voices: without one, Rocco imitates with text only.
rocco.config.tip.impression_search: If a character isn't on the list, look for a public voice with that name on Fish Audio and remember it.
rocco.personality.title: Personality
rocco.personality.button.tip: Chill, Unfiltered or made to measure: how he treats you, how much he teases, his fears, his story.
rocco.personality.mode.chill.tip: Friendly and respectful, if a little full of himself.
rocco.personality.mode.sin_filtro.tip: The full Rocco: teasing, swearing and dark humor.
rocco.personality.test.tip: Rocco introduces himself in one sentence with this personality. Uses your AI key.
rocco.personality.hint.preset: This is how this mode is. To change traits, pick Custom.
rocco.personality.hint.custom: Tweak each trait. Applies from the next reply.
rocco.config.tip.origin: Where Rocco came from and why he helps you. "Written by me" uses the text below.
rocco.config.tip.custom_origin: Rocco's story, written by you. Only with Origin story = Written by me.
rocco.config.tip.treatment: Kind: never disrespects you. Teasing: roasts you like a friend. Merciless: tears you apart, but only about your play.
rocco.config.tip.swearing: How much bad language slips out.
rocco.config.tip.sarcasm: From a gentle wink to sharp irony.
rocco.config.tip.ego: How full of himself he is.
rocco.config.tip.dark_humor: Jokes about death and misfortune (always in the game).
rocco.config.tip.dark_side: His hidden psychopath, who now and then slips out against the game's mobs.
rocco.config.tip.jealousy: How he gets when something steals your attention.
rocco.config.tip.spontaneous: How often he says something when it's quiet.
rocco.config.tip.length: How much he talks in each reply.
rocco.config.tip.questions: How much he asks about your plans and tastes.
rocco.config.tip.facts: How many Minecraft fun facts he drops.
rocco.config.tip.life_advice: Now and then he tells you to drink water or take a break.
rocco.config.tip.fourth_wall: Whether he ever talks about the game as a game.
rocco.config.tip.impressions: Whether he imitates characters and celebrities when you ask. Applies to every mode.
rocco.config.tip.spontaneous_impressions: Whether he sometimes imitates someone without being asked.
rocco.config.tip.fears: Terrified of endermen, fire and the void.
rocco.config.tip.potato: Call him a potato and he gets indignant.
rocco.config.tip.trust_pace: How fast you become friends. The closer you are, the bolder he gets.
rocco.config.tip.dialect: How he talks. Automatic follows your game language. Applies to every mode.
rocco.config.tip.nickname: What he calls you sometimes. Empty: none. Applies to every mode.
rocco.config.tip.extra_notes: Anything you want to add to how he is (up to 800 letters). Never overrides his limits.
rocco.config.tip.own_file: Use your personality file instead of these traits. /rocco personalidad reset writes the current one there for you to edit.
rocco.test.offline: No connection (or the service isn't answering).
rocco.test.rate_limit: You hit the usage limit, try again later.
rocco.command.personality.modes: Change it with /rocco personalidad chill | sin_filtro | personalizado, or in Mods > Rocco > Config > Personality.
rocco.command.personality.outdated: Your file is from an older version. /rocco personalidad reset rebuilds it (overwrites your changes).
rocco.command.personality.changed: Done: Rocco is now %s. You'll notice from the next reply.
rocco.command.personality.needs_debug: Turn on "More detail in the log" (Config > Advanced AI) to use this command.
rocco.command.personality.dumped: Saved the prompt to %s (%s characters, about %s tokens).
rocco.command.personality.reset: Wrote the current personality to %s. To use it: Custom mode and "Use my own file".
rocco.setup.button.tip: The assistant to get Rocco ready: keys, voice, microphone and personality.
rocco.setup.title: Rocco
rocco.setup.subtitle: Get him ready in a couple of minutes.
rocco.setup.welcome.title: Hi!
rocco.setup.welcome.text: I'm Rocco, a miracle of nature. To really chat I need a brain: a free AI key. Voice and microphone are optional.
rocco.setup.remote: On this server, the owner sets Rocco up: what you set here only applies to your own worlds.
rocco.setup.brain.title: Rocco's brain
rocco.setup.brain.text: Pick a provider, get the free key and paste it (Ctrl+V). Without a key, Rocco uses his own lines and understands simple orders.
rocco.setup.brain.model.tip: "auto" picks the best available model by itself. Recommended.
rocco.setup.brain.fallback: If it fails, use my other keys
rocco.setup.brain.fallback.tip: If this provider doesn't answer or runs out of quota, try the others you have set up.
rocco.setup.brain.ollama: Ollama runs on your PC and needs no key. Install it and open it before testing.
rocco.setup.voice.title: Rocco's voice (optional)
rocco.setup.voice.text: With Fish Audio, Rocco speaks out loud. You need the key and a voice ID.
rocco.setup.voice.id.tip: The voice's "reference id" on Fish Audio: it's the voice Rocco speaks with.
rocco.setup.voice.sample_line: Hi. I'm Rocco, a miracle of nature. This is how I sound.
rocco.setup.voice.ok: It works. Did you hear it?
rocco.setup.talk.title: Talking to Rocco
rocco.setup.talk.text: Write to him in the normal chat, near him. The microphone is optional (Deepgram).
rocco.setup.talk.name: Only if I say his name
rocco.setup.mic.language.tip: Short code: es, en, pt, multi...
rocco.setup.mic.key.tip: Change it in the Rocco category of the controls.
rocco.setup.mic.silence: I didn't hear anything. Is the microphone OK?
rocco.setup.personality.title: Personality
rocco.setup.personality.chill: Chill: friendly and respectful, if a little full of himself.
rocco.setup.personality.chill.example: "You're welcome. It's what I do. Well, what I do very well."
rocco.setup.personality.sin_filtro: Unfiltered: the full Rocco. Teasing, swearing and dark humor.
rocco.setup.personality.sin_filtro.examp: "Want me to draw you a picture, genius?"
rocco.setup.personality.later: You can change or customize it any time in the settings.
rocco.setup.language.title: Language
rocco.setup.summary.title: Summary
rocco.setup.summary.brain: Rocco can think and answer you
rocco.setup.summary.mic: Rocco can hear you through the microphone
rocco.setup.privacy.title: Privacy
rocco.setup.privacy.text: What you say to Rocco and some data about your game are sent to the providers you choose. Your keys are stored only on your computer.
rocco.personality.migrate: [Rocco] You have an edited personality from an older version in %s. To keep using it: Mods > Rocco > Config > Personality, Custom mode and "Use my own file".

rocco.tutorial.title: Rocco Quick Guide
rocco.tutorial.page.1.title: Meet Rocco
rocco.tutorial.page.1.line.1: Talk to him in chat (or by microphone) when he is close. He understands simple orders like "follow me" or "stay here".
rocco.tutorial.page.1.line.2: He follows you everywhere: flying, swimming, even by boat. If he gets lost, he shows up next to you.
rocco.tutorial.page.1.line.3: He is cocky but lovable. With a free AI key he really chats.
rocco.tutorial.page.1.tip: Use the ← and → keys to change page.
rocco.tutorial.page.2.title: Storing your things
rocco.tutorial.page.2.line.1: Right click on Rocco opens his lid: an inventory of 27 slots that grows with backpacks.
rocco.tutorial.page.2.line.2: Tell him "store everything" and he puts it in your chests. "Sort the chests" tidies them up.
rocco.tutorial.page.2.line.3: Ask "bring me coal" and he goes looking. Ask "where did you store it?" and he tells you which chest.
rocco.tutorial.page.2.tip: What he is wearing (armor, weapon and shield) is never stored.
rocco.tutorial.page.3.title: Looking after the house
rocco.tutorial.page.3.line.1: Tell him "stay and look after the house" and he stays there while you explore.
rocco.tutorial.page.3.line.2: He harvests and replants the garden and looks after the animals: shears sheep, feeds them and collects drops.
rocco.tutorial.page.3.line.3: When you come back he tells you what he did. To stop him: "follow me" or "come here".
rocco.tutorial.page.3.tip: He never touches named, leashed or tamed animals.
rocco.tutorial.page.4.title: His menu
rocco.tutorial.page.4.line.1: Sneak + right-click opens his menu: what he is doing, how good friends you are and whether his magic is ready.
rocco.tutorial.page.4.line.2: It has buttons to follow, wait, sit, sleep, dance, brew you a mate and sort the chests.
rocco.tutorial.page.4.line.3: You also save places for him to guide you to, and choose his gear and who he may attack.
rocco.tutorial.page.4.tip: In multiplayer, the menu is for the owner only.
rocco.tutorial.page.5.title: When you need him
rocco.tutorial.page.5.line.1: If Rocco gets lost, use /rocco llamar or the key in Controls > Rocco.
rocco.tutorial.page.5.line.2: If he dies, he comes back buried near you: right-click the mound to dig him out.
rocco.tutorial.page.5.line.3: AI, voice and microphone are set up in Mods > Rocco > Config.
rocco.tutorial.page.5.tip: To see this guide again, bind a key in Controls > Rocco.
